The dentist uses tweezers to extract a small green leaf from the man's mouth. (3) A close-up shot shows a stainless steel tray where the dentist drops the tiny green leaf. (4) Back in the dental office, the dentist pulls out a large, fully intact head of green broccoli from the man's open mouth. (5) Another close-up displays the broccoli resting on the metal tray. (6) A POV shot from the patient's perspective looks up at the dentist and assistant. The dentist holds up a giant brown meatball on a dental probe. (7) The dental assistant gestures while talking to the patient in the wide office shot; the patient looks surprised and muffled. (8) A second POV shot shows the dentist holding a whole, cooked orange shrimp with a dental tool. (9) The trio continues their discussion in the office; the patient appears embarrassed while the staff gives advice.
